exchanges.client: Baddi 3elbet Euthyrox 50mcg tablets la 7 iyem, lyom, 3ande siyyara, budget 10 USD.
exchanges.reply:
Lqit Euthyrox 50mcg (tablets) 3nd 3 saydaliyyat, kellon bel car, lyom, 7 ayyam.
Nasiha: Beirut Pharmacy 1. Bta3mel 5 da2ye bel car, w sa3to la 17:00 lyom. Si3ro 234,000 LBP (about $2.61)، w bta3ti fare2 ma3 l 3oumr la2ab.
Khiyarat tenyé: Beirut Pharmacy 2, 7 da2ye bel car, msakkar la 22:00, 293,000 LBP (about $3.27). Matn Pharmacy 9 arkhas (156,000 LBP, about $1.74) bass 18 da2ye bel car, w sa3to la 22:00.
Hayda el dawa bde wasfe tibbiyye: jibo lal saydaliyye.
Ma fiye tiḥjez 3ando ba3d ma tedghot l zer.
